preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Length of each string s is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, s consists only of '+' and '-'
preconditions.description: String s contains only plus and minus signs.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, return the number of promising non-empty substrings of s
postconditions.description: The output is the count of promising non-empty substrings for each test case.
